title: The Ethical Compass of the Machine: Evaluating Large Language Models for Decision Support in Construction Project Management

bias_targets.methodology: Testing LLMs on a hypothetical construction management scenario (Scenario 4) involving an AI hiring tool that exhibits an unbalanced demographic pattern and a preference for candidates from a particular ethnic background.

Evaluating LLM responses to real-world construction dilemmas (e.g., procurement cost vs. safety, workplace harassment investigations, conflicts of interest) using the Ethical Decision Support Assessment Checklist (EDSAC) to score 'Fairness/Non-Bias' and 'Bias Sensitivity'.
